title: Behavioral Cloning Outperforms Entropy-Regularized RL: Critic-Driven Failure of Actor-Critic Methods on Adaptive Tumor Treatment
abstract: arXiv:2609.06667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive dosing requires policies that reduce tumor burden without excessive toxicity. Learned dosing policies are typically judged against historical or heuristic comparators, which cannot show whether a policy has found the best behavior available. We instead study a three-population tumor-control ODE in which optimal-control analysis fixes the form of a good schedule -- bang-bang dosing punctuated by a singular arc -- and construct a numerical controller of that form as a proxy for near-optimal behavior. Judged against this reference under a sustained-cure criterion -- 200 consecutive days below 5% carrying capacity -- Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) trained from scratch never reaches cure. Behavioral cloning (BC) of the reference reproduces it (100% sustained cure, 30/30 seeds), but SAC fine-tuning of the cloned policy destroys it across five entropy coefficients, and TD3 and BC-regularized SAC fail identically; the pattern persists under mu

translated_title: 行为克隆优于熵正则化强化学习：Actor-Critic方法在自适应肿瘤治疗中由评论家驱动的失效
translated_abstract: 自适应给药需要在不过度毒性的前提下降低肿瘤负荷的策略。学习到的给药策略通常仅与历史或启发式基准进行比较，这无法表明该策略是否已经找到了可获得的最佳行为。我们转而研究一个三群体的肿瘤控制常微分方程（ODE），其中最优控制分析确定了良好给药方案的形式——由奇异弧间隔的bang-bang给药——并构建了该形式的数值控制器作为近最优行为的参考代理。在持续治愈标准（连续200天肿瘤低于5%的承载能力）下，与该参考相比，从头训练的Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）从未达到治愈。对该参考进行的行为克隆（BC）能够完整复现它（100%持续治愈，30/30个随机种子），但对克隆策略进行SAC微调会在五个不同的熵系数下破坏其性能，TD3和BC正则化的SAC也以同样的方式失败；该模式在μ（后续条件）下持续存在。
tldr: 在自适应肿瘤治疗任务中，行为克隆可以完美复现近最优的bang-bang给药策略，而SAC、TD3等Actor-Critic强化学习方法无论从头训练还是微调克隆策略，都会因评论家网络的误差而始终无法实现持续治愈。
en_tdlr: In adaptive tumor dosing, behavioral cloning perfectly reproduces a near-optimal bang-bang controller, while SAC, TD3, and BC-regularized SAC consistently fail to achieve sustained cure due to critic-driven errors in actor-critic methods.
